subject.title: [codex] fix discord missing voice state handling

question: Should this PR wait for reviewer-inspectable live Discord proof at the current head, or may a maintainer accept private live validation for the code-10065 voiceStatus behavior change?
rationale: The code and tests support the fix, but the changed behavior depends on Discord's live REST response and the public PR evidence still lacks inspectable redacted output, logs, recording, or an explicit override.

options.title: Require inspectable proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Discord terminal output, logs, or a recording showing code 10065 returns absent while unrelated errors such as code 10004 still surface.

options.title: Accept maintainer-owned proof
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly record a proof override for the exact head if private live validation is sufficient for this merge.

options.title: Keep paused
options.body: Leave the PR open until the author or maintainer can attach inspectable Discord proof instead of merging on tests and prose claims alone.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Discord terminal output, logs, or a recording showing code 10065 returns absent while unrelated errors such as code 10004 still surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned, provided the recent proof comment, and has the strongest recent history on the touched Discord REST and voice paths.
